social_rules: All spoken promises of significant weight must be registered with the Public Promise Registrar.
Failure to fulfill a registered promise incurs a promise tax, assessed by the Promise Tax Auditor.
Promise debts are legally binding and can be collected by Senior Debt Couriers.
Attempts to deliberately evade promise taxes or debt collection are considered a breach of civic trust.
Information regarding promise debts and tax assessments is considered public record, accessible via the Archivist of Forgotten Promises.
Generated gameplay loops should create follow-up choices instead of dead ends.
Player entry points should remain understandable through local conversation, movement, and inspection.
Conflict hook: A newly discovered ancient text contradicts current Promise Tax Authority valuation algorithms, leading to widespread challenges of existing debts.
Conflict hook: The Courier Guild goes on strike, refusing to deliver debt notices until their hazardous working conditions and low wages are addressed, causing collective promise debt to skyrocket.
Conflict hook: A prominent Council Elder is found to have secretly defaulted on a significant promise, eroding inter-citizen trust and challenging the Council's moral authority.
Conflict hook: A powerful Shrewd Merchant attempts to buy up all outstanding promise debts at a discount, planning to enforce them rigorously and destabilize the market.
